summary: Make the version-2 backup authority replicate, settle and promote at scale: build without staging, pack pages, drop the page-version capability, gate only growth, collect page roots after failures. API impact: changed contract.

guide.reason: A capacity refusal no longer stops an admitted run from recording its outcome while a member is offline.

api.reason: backup_page_version is removed from PoolReplicaStatus and PoolReplicaAck and the pool-backup-authority-pages-v1/v2 capabilities are no longer advertised (project owner: no mixed-version compatibility). Version-2 page boundaries are content-chosen, the backup-page progress probe returns 500 on a read failure, and settlement is not refused for member replica state. No route or authentication change; Controller never read the removed field.

roadmap.reason: Corrects defects in the existing recovery slice.

state.reason: No new durable record. Page roots and blobs remain Core-owned derived staging of the master's existing backup stores.

verification.method: Six focused Core regressions failed against the staged sources through go test -overlay and pass after the fix, also under -race. Existing authority, promotion, transfer, settlement and catalog tests were rerun by focused regex.
verification.limits: No lab, native host or forge CI run. Replica-per-page request overhead remains, reduced by packing.
